messages:
maria: Heads-up — I ran a small repro on the paged-attn branch to stress block table growth. Seeing repeated OOMs when sequence_len spikes > 12k.
ryan: ugh. which alloc path? slab or hybrid?
maria: hybrid. allocation trace looks like repeated small slab allocations + large fallback to heap. suspect fragmentation.
ashok: can you paste the alloc trace? also which kernel selected — fused or flash variant?
maria: here's the snippet from the test container:
```
E 12:34:21 alloc_block slab_idx=3 size=65536 free=0
E 12:34:21 fallback_heap_alloc size=196608 ptr=0x7fae...
E 12:34:22 page_table_grow new_pages=4
E 12:34:22 OOM: kv_cache couldn't reserve 256MB
```
maria: and we were on kernel=fused_attn_v2 (auto-selected), batch_size=8, seq=12800
dana: auto-selection could be wrong here. fused has larger peak memory due to intermediate buffers.
ryan: agreed. we should prefer paged-friendly flash variant for very long seqs. flash has smaller transient footprint even if a bit slower.
ashok: is batching heuristic considering sequence length distribution? maybe our picker only looked at avg seq len and not tail.
maria: picker currently picks based on avg_token_count per minute + GPU_util threshold. not tail-aware.
ashok: propose change: add p95_seq_len and a penalty term if p95 > 8k -> bias to flash/paged kernels or smaller internal block size.
dana: also we should try adaptive block-table compaction: when fragmentation ratio > 0.7, trigger compact pass to coalesce free slots.
ryan: +1. compacting during low-util windows. add telemetry for fragmentation ratio per shard.
infra-bot: deploy-started: paged-attn/alloc-tuning-1742 -> canary 3 nodes
maria: test results after canary: OOMs dropped to 0 in 2h, p95 latency increased ~4% but tail latency improved for heavy seqs.
ashok: good tradeoff. can we add a quick patch to runtime to log kernel decision with p50/p95 so we can validate over time?
dana: will draft patch. also adding a small safe-fallback that switches kernel if mem margin < 20% at request time.
ryan: one more thing — add a small repro harness in eng-runtime/bench to run seq-length sweeps and record peak RSS per kernel. helps regression tests.
maria: awesome. I'll add the bench and upload traces. thanks all :rocket:
